messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Ordering of R Structures?
parts:
If I have rdump data for a matrix, say,

x <- structure(c(…), .Dim = c(n_rows, n_cols))

are the values “…” in row-major or column-major
order? In other words, are the first n_rows values
of “…” the first row of the matrix or are the first
n_cols values of “…” the first column of the matrix?

Thanks.

-Mike

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Ordering of R Structures?
parts:
Column major (or in general, last-index major). We followed
their order in the CmdStan input format.

- Bob
